en: A black‑and‑white view of a large, elongated neo‑Gothic / neo‑Renaissance style building with multiple steep-roofed corner towers and dormers, set behind a line of leafless trees. In the right background is a tall, slender church spire. In the foreground stretches a wide open field or parade ground with several small groups of people, possibly soldiers drilling, and a single figure walking toward the camera. The image has film scratches and dust typical of early 20th‑century photography. No printed title or caption is visible on the image.
